annotation.title_clean: 深圳经济特区智能网联汽车管理条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations on the Administration of Intelligent Connected Vehicles in the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 深圳市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress)
annotation.venue: 深圳市人民政府公报 2022年第26期
annotation.summary_en: Shenzhen's local statute, effective 1 August 2022, regulating intelligent connected (autonomous) vehicles: road testing and demonstration, product market access and registration, use rules by automation level, vehicle-road infrastructure, cybersecurity and data protection, traffic violation and accident liability, and penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines conditional, high and full automation; drivers must be present and ready to take over for the first two levels.
Product catalogue market access, testing, and registration required before sale or road use; mandatory insurance.
Driverless fully autonomous vehicles are restricted to designated areas; owners or managers bear liability, with recourse against producers for defects.
Event data recorder must store at least 90 seconds of pre-accident data for 30 days.
Data localisation, cybersecurity assessment, bans on illegal personal data collection, and fines for violations.
